out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: EHS OBSERVED NO HAND WASHING SOAP AT THE HAND WASHING SINK IN KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. PIC PROVIDED HAND SOAP FOR HAND WASHING SINK AT TIME OF INSPECTION.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: EHS OBSERVED FROZEN CHICKEN AND FROZEN STEAK THAWING AT AMBIET TEMPERATURE IN THE 3 VAT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THE 3 PROPER WAY TO THAW FOODS. PIC MOVED THE THAWING CHICKEN AND STEAK TO THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR TO FINSIH THAWING PROPERLY.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: EHS OBSERVED MULTIPLE KNIVES BEING STORED BETWEEN THE WALL AND SHELVING UNIT IN THE KICHEN ABOVE THE 3 VAT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THE PROPER WAY TO STORE IN-USE UTENSILS. PIC MOVED THE KNIVES TO BE WASHED, RINSED AND SANITIZED BEFORE BEING PROPERLY STORED AWAY.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at the only handwashing sink in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC WAS ABLE TO PROVIDE PAPER TOWELS FOR THE HAND SINK IN THE KITCHEN.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. PIC PROVIDED A BOTTLE OF HAND SOAP FOR THE HAND SINK IN THE KITCHEN.

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located in the kitchen was blocked by a bag of towels, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. PIC REMOVED THE BAG OF TOWLES FROM THE HAND SINK. MANDARIN RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 03/26/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Pooled eggs in a container submerged in an ice bath was temping at 60F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL COLD FOODS NEED TO HELD AT A MAXIMUM TEMPERATURE OF 41F. PIC HAD EMPLOYEE MOVE THE POOLED EGGS TO THE WALK-IN TO PROPERLY COOL DOWN.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: multiple food items in the walk-in refrigerator need to have a date mark put on them.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL FOODS NEED TO HAVE A DATE MARK ON THEM SINCE FOOD CAN ONLY BE USED FOR A TOTAL OF 7 DAYS. PIC HAD EMPLOYEE BEGIN WRITING THE PREPARATION DATE ON THE PLASTIC WRAP THAT WRAPPED THE FOODS IN THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Toilet Rooms Enclosed
violations.observation: Both men’s and women’s toilet room door is not provided with a self-closing door.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a self-closing hinge or closing mechanism for the toilet room door. PLEASE INSTALL SELF-CLOSING DOOR EQUIPMENT ON BOTH MEN’S AND WOMEN’S TOLIET ROOM DOORS BEFORE NEXT INSPECTION.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: raw chicken was being stored in walk-in refrigerator next to raw beef and pork.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT ALL RAW FOODS NEED TO BE ORGANIZED BY COOK TEMPERATURES WITH CHICKEN ALWAYS BEING STORED ON THE BOTTOM. EHS WILL PROVIDE PIC WITH ORGANIZATION CHART FOR WALK IN.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: cooked shrimp and cooked noodles where being stored above and next to raw chicken and raw shell eggs.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT RAW FOOD SHOULD NOT BE STORED NEXT TO OR ABOVE RTE FOODS. PIC HAD EMPLOYEES BEGIN TO REORGANIZE THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Facility is storing glue traps in dry stock area that a pest control operator did not provide.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT THEY MUST HAVE A PEST CONTROL OPERATOR PLACE TRAPS FOR MIC.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage Prohibited under Sewer Lines
violations.observation: Opened food coloring bottles were being stored underneath the plumbing for the spray sink and dishwasher.
violations.corrective_action: Food may not be stored under sewer lines that are not shielded to intercept potential drips. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT FOOD CAN NOT BE STORED UNDER SEWEGE PIPES. MANDARIN RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 11/20/2024) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Miscellaneous Source Contamination
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were found subject to contamination after receipt and during storage due to the condition as described: Food is being stored in non food grade safe containers.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 through 3-306. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT FOOD MUST STORED IN CONTAINERS THAT ARE LABELED AS FOOD GRADE OR HAS THE APPROVED NSF STAMP ON THE BOTTOM.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: Knives were being stored in small gap between shelf and wall, that is not easily cleanable or able to be sanitized.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT UTENSILS CAN ONLY BE STORED IN PLACES THAT CAN BE PROPERLY CLEANED AND SANITIZED. PIC MOVED KNIVES AFTER DISCUSSING WITH EHS.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the back door in kitchen is not maintained in good repair and is too short for the door frame allowing the potential of pest to come in.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT THE BACK DOOR TO THE KITCHEN NEEDS TO BE REPLACED OR FIXED SO FITS THE DOOR FRAME TO PREVENT PESTS.
